import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def max_rects(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); out=[]
    for r1 in range(H-4):
        for c1 in range(W-4):
            v=I[r1][c1]; mw=0
            while c1+mw<W and I[r1][c1+mw]==v: mw+=1
            if mw<5: continue
            for h in range(5,H-r1+1):
                if not all(I[r1+i][c1+c]==v for i in range(h) for c in range(mw)): break
                r2=r1+h-1; c2=c1+mw-1
                if (c1>0 and all(I[i][c1-1]==v for i in range(r1,r2+1))) or \
                   (r1>0 and all(I[r1-1][c]==v for c in range(c1,c2+1))) or \
                   (r2<H-1 and all(I[r2+1][c]==v for c in range(c1,c2+1))) or \
                   (c2<W-1 and all(I[i][c2+1]==v for i in range(c1,c2+1))):
                    continue
                out.append((v,h,mw,(r1,c1),(r2,c2)))
    return out
